audience: studio and wellness owners who run classes and appointments in Mindbody

useCases.title: See a class roster and how full classes are
useCases.text: The AI lists classes in a date range with teacher, location, capacity and booked and waitlist counts, and opens one class to read its roster.

useCases.title: Check a client's visits, memberships and balance
useCases.text: The AI finds a client by name or email, then reads past and scheduled visits, active memberships with remaining counts and expiry, and the account balance.

useCases.title: Review sales and pricing options
useCases.text: The AI lists completed sales in a date range with items, payments and client, and the class packs, drop-ins and intro offers for sale.

useCases.title: Review or update booked appointments
useCases.text: The AI lists booked appointments by staff, client or date range. It can reschedule one, or change its time, staff, notes or status, for example confirm or arrive.

useCases.title: Book a client into a class or an appointment
useCases.text: The AI books a client into a class or its waiting list, or finds open slots for a session type and books an appointment with a staff member. No card is charged.

useCases.title: Add or update a client record
useCases.text: The AI creates a new client with first and last name, or changes fields on an existing client. No card or billing data is accepted.
